cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Can I keep one plant on your windowsill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.

mechanism: A uses its gardening pupil permission for one plant as the accepted light-sharing principle with which to argue for a whole tray.
confusable: Not mere extra request after consent: A derives the larger demand from the reason B has just accepted for the smaller one.
comparison: Windowsill access expanded by equal light need versus speech credit expanded by argument structure.
